ports.note: Windows names; RtMidi appends the port number ("Oxygen 61 MKV 0"), so match the start of the name

mode_report.note: DAW/PRESET toggles and reports the new mode as CC 112 / 113 value 127

knobs.note: The DAW-port CCs are sent in both modes; the preset-mode CCs depend on the selected preset

faders.note: Index 8 (CC 41) is fader 9, the master fader

pads.note: Bottom row 36-39, top row 40-43; velocity was always 127 (fixed-velocity setting)

transport.note: Each button sends CC value 127 on press and 0 on release; play and rec also send FF on the main port

mode_buttons.note: The two MODE arrow buttons next to DAW/PRESET; value 127 on press, 0 on release

octave_transpose.note: OCTAVE/TRANSPOSE -/+ send no message; they shift the key notes inside the keyboard (middle C 60 -> 72 -> 48)

daw_button_mode.note: DAW BUTTON MODE cycles four modes and reports the active one as CC 58-61 value 127
